Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
rec_cnt number(8);
begin
nullchk;
select count(*) into rec_cnt from suppliers where supplier_code = :s_supplier_code and trunc(sysdate) between
trunc(eff_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date), sysdate+365);
if rec_cnt = 0 then
show_error('2301');
else
select supplier_name into :s_supplier_desc from suppliers where supplier_code = :s_supplier_code;
go_item('s_date_start');
end if;
exception
when no_data_found then
check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
recc_cnt number(10);
begin
if :s_date_start is not null then
nullchk;
check_package_failure;
end if;
if :s_date_start is not null and :s_date_end is not null then 
select count(*) into recc_cnt from reagent_store_mst where supplier_code = :s_supplier_code and
(:global.user_testing_lab_code = '99' or lab_code = :global.user_testing_lab_code) and 
(( :s_date_start is null ) or ( :s_date_start is not null and received_date between :s_date_start and 
:s_date_end));
 
if recc_cnt = 0 then
show_error('2331');
else
go_block('reagent_store_mst');
execute_query;
end if;
elsif :s_date_start is null and :s_date_end is null then
if recc_cnt = 0 then
show_error('2331');
else
go_block('reagent_store_mst');
execute_query;
end if;
 end if;
exception
when value_error then
show_error('1706');
check_package_failure;
 when others then
check_package_failure;
handle_error;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
if :reject_reason_code is not null then
select code_desc into :reject_reason_desc from master_codes where

and test_id = :reagent_store_mst.test_id;

end;
